w10_T4_006106: A garden centre had 191 rose bushes in its beds, and a grower delivered 73 more. A landscaping firm then bought 181 bushes. Each bush still at the centre was divided into 4 cuttings. A visitor donated 6 more cuttings, but a dozen cuttings dried out and were thrown away. Every cutting is packed for sale with 7 fertiliser pellets, and Sana prepared more cuttings than her colleague Bruno did. How many fertiliser pellets does the centre need?
w10_T4_006109: A school kitchen had 107 crates of milk in the cold room, and the dairy delivered 40 more. Each crate holds 4 cartons. A shop then gave the kitchen 50 loose cartons, and a parent brought 30 more. Every carton fills 4 glasses at breakfast club. Mrs Ade ordered more cartons this term than Mr Boye did. How many glasses of milk can the kitchen pour?
w10_T4_006116: On Monday morning a market stall had 14 boxes of strawberries, and a farm delivered 47 more before noon. In the early afternoon 20 boxes were sold to a hotel, and later 29 boxes went to a cafe. In the evening a second farm brought 10 boxes to the stall. Each box holds 6 punnets of strawberries. The stall pays 25 dollars a day for its pitch. How many punnets does the stall have?
w10_T4_006119: A swimming pool records its sessions in minutes and posts the timetable in hours. The pool had 102 kickboards in its store, and 47 were taken to the teaching pool. A school then borrowed 10 more. Each kickboard still in the store is stacked with 4 floats, and every float is cut from 2 foam blocks. How many foam blocks are in the store's floats?
w10_T4_006121: A bus depot records its journeys in minutes but prints the timetable in hours. The depot had 192 ticket rolls, and each roll holds 6 books of tickets. Drivers used 1069 books during the month. A printer then delivered 80 books, and a spare cupboard gave up 45 more, but a rival depot borrowed 166. Hilda issued more books than her colleague Otto did, and a dozen buses are washed each night. How many books of tickets does the depot have?
w10_T4_006122: A recycling centre had 166 sacks of cans, and a collection added 44 sacks and then 22 more. Each sack holds 9 boxes of cans. A school then donated 49 boxes. Every box holds 8 cans. Ferdi collected more sacks than his colleague Lotte did, and the centre opens at 7 each morning. How many cans does the centre have?
w10_T4_006124: A juice factory measures its output in millilitres and labels the bottles in litres. The factory had 71 crates of lemons, and a dozen more crates arrived from Spain. Each crate holds 5 sacks of lemons. A storm then spoiled 333 sacks. Every good sack fills 5 jugs of juice, and each jug fills 6 bottles. How many bottles can the factory fill?
w10_T4_006129: A publisher had 208 crates of books in the warehouse, and the printer sent 5 more. Each crate holds 7 parcels, and every parcel holds 6 books. The publisher then sold 8169 books to a chain of shops. Ravi handled more crates than his colleague Tess did, and the warehouse is 60 metres long. How many books does the publisher have left?
w10_T4_006134: A campsite had 60 bundles of firewood, and a forester delivered 22 more. Each bundle holds 7 logs. A camper then brought 3 logs from home, and the warden found 9 logs behind the shed. The campsite has 45 pitches. How many logs are on the campsite?
w10_T4_006135: A museum shop had 79 boxes of postcards on each of its 4 shelves. Every box holds 6 postcards. A designer then delivered 39 loose postcards, a gallery sent 59, and an artist gave 9. A dozen posters hang above the till, and the museum charges 15 dollars for entry. How many postcards does the shop have?
w10_T4_006138: A theatre counts its interval sales in cents and banks them in dollars. On Monday morning the store held 99 tubs of ice cream, and a delivery added 51 more. In the afternoon the tubs were shared equally among the theatre's 3 kiosks, and the foyer kiosk took its share. In the evening a supplier brought 78 more tubs to the foyer kiosk, and 127 tubs were sold during the show. Each tub still at that kiosk fills 3 cones. The theatre seats 600 people. How many cones can the foyer kiosk fill?
w10_T4_006140: A wholesaler weighs its coffee in grams although the sacks are marked in kilograms. The store had 218 sacks, and each sack holds 6 tins of coffee. A roaster then sent 76 loose tins. All of the tins were shared equally among the wholesaler's 4 shops, and the shop on Bridge Street took its share. That shop sold 197 tins during the month. How many tins are left in the Bridge Street shop?
w10_T4_006144: A school counts its swimming lessons in minutes and reports them to parents in hours. The pool store held 71 pairs of goggles. A class took 29 pairs, and a swimming club took 23 more. 12 pairs were broken and thrown away, and 2 pairs were lost. A supplier then delivered 72 new pairs. The pool is 25 metres long. How many pairs of goggles are in the store?
w10_T4_006154: Bea had 19 boxes of tiles in her hallway, and a delivery brought 34 more. A friend gave her 8 boxes, and a clearance sale added 67 more. Each box holds 3 packs, and every pack holds 2 tiles. Bea now has more boxes than her brother Milo has in his garage. How many tiles does Bea have?
w10_T4_006155: A youth club records its hall time in minutes and posts it on the door in hours. The club had 24 footballs in its store cupboard. A donation added 31 balls. A school then borrowed 20 balls, and 27 balls were found flat and thrown out. A coach later brought 8 new balls. How many footballs are in the cupboard?
w10_T4_006167: A cake shop baked 21 trays of muffins, and each tray holds 9 muffins. 59 muffins were sold before lunch. A second bake added 54 muffins, and a coach party then bought 70. Each muffin still in the shop is cut into 5 tasting pieces for the fair. The shop has 3 ovens. How many tasting pieces does the shop have?
w10_T4_006170: Nils had 113 sheets of stamps in his collection, and an auction added 75 sheets. He then sold 42 sheets to a dealer. Each sheet holds 9 blocks, and every block holds 7 stamps. Nils owns more stamps than his sister Frida does. How many stamps does Nils own?
w10_T4_006176: A bakery had 214 sacks of flour, and each sack fills 5 tubs of dough. A second mixer then doubled the number of tubs the bakery had. Every tub is divided into 3 trays. The trays were shared equally among the bakery's 6 ovens, and Nora took the oven by the door. She baked 934 trays during the day, while her colleague Piet baked fewer at his own oven. How many trays are still waiting at Nora's oven?
w10_T4_006180: On Monday morning a farm shop had 80 boxes of eggs, and a farmer brought 21 more before lunch. In the afternoon the boxes were opened, and each box holds 6 eggs. In the early evening a neighbour gave the shop 5 loose eggs, and just before closing a second neighbour brought 21 more. How many eggs are in the farm shop?
w10_T4_006185: On Monday morning a florist had 71 stems of lilies. Before lunch 44 stems were used in bouquets, and in the early afternoon 3 stems wilted and were thrown away. Later that afternoon the florist cut every remaining stem into 3 short sprigs for table decorations. In the evening 1 sprig was dropped on the floor and 3 more were given to a customer. The shop closes at 6. How many sprigs does the florist have?
w10_T4_006190: A hotel had 88 rolls of wallpaper in its store, and a decorator brought 6 more. 7 rolls were damaged by damp and thrown out. Each roll covers 5 panels of wall, and every panel needs 3 strips of paper. The decorator then found 8 spare strips in his van. A dozen ladders are kept in the yard. How many strips of paper does the hotel have?
w10_T4_006196: On Monday morning a hostel had 134 towels in the linen room. Before lunch 40 towels went to the laundry, and a guest returned 5. In the afternoon the laundry delivered 76 clean towels. In the evening 96 towels were taken up to the rooms, and 51 more were sent to a sister hostel. The hostel has 60 beds. How many towels are in the linen room?
w10_T4_006208: On Monday morning a printer had 74 reams of paper, and a supplier delivered 51 more before lunch. In the afternoon each ream was fed into a machine that prints 6 booklets from it. In the evening a colleague brought 56 finished booklets over from another branch. Every booklet holds 5 vouchers. Sasha printed more booklets that day than her colleague Nikolai did, and a dozen machines run in the workshop. How many vouchers does the printer have?
w10_T4_006214: A hardware shop had 53 boxes of screws on each of its 8 racks. A delivery then added 45 loose boxes. Each box holds 3 packets, and every packet holds 3 screws. The shop has 2 checkouts. How many screws are in the shop?
w10_T4_006219: On Monday morning a fruit packer filled 196 trays on each of its 7 lines. Before lunch a farm delivered 74 more trays, and in the afternoon a second farm sent 37. In the evening 1111 trays were loaded onto lorries for the supermarkets. The packing shed has 9 doors. How many trays are still in the shed?
